ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The upper part of the figure gives two half-wave rectifier modules P and Q and their transfer characteristics. P's transfer graph shows: when the input is the positive half-cycle, the output becomes a negative value along a negative-slope line, and when the input is the negative half-cycle, the output is 0; Q's transfer graph shows: when the input is the negative half-cycle, the output is a positive value, and when the input is the positive half-cycle, the output is 0. The lower part gives four candidate circuits A, B, C, and D, where in figure B, P's output is connected through resistor R to the inverting terminal of the op-amp, and there is an equal-valued feedback resistor R; Q's output is connected through resistor R to the non-inverting terminal, and the non-inverting terminal is also connected to ground through an equal-valued resistor R. Reasoning: From the voltage division relation at the non-inverting terminal of figure B, V+ = Q/2. Under ideal op-amp negative feedback, V- = V+ = Q/2. Write KCL at the inverting node, and since the input resistor and feedback resistor are equal, (V- - P)/R + (V- - vo)/R = 0, so vo = 2V- - P = Q - P. Check the half-cycles: when the input is positive, Q = 0 and P is negative, so vo = Q - P is positive; when the input is negative, P = 0 and Q is positive, so vo = Q - P is also positive. The output is positive in both half-cycles, which is a full-wave rectified output. Therefore figure B should be selected.

raw_record.question_text: Among the labeled circuit diagrams shown, which diagram represents the full-wave rectifier obtained by using the two given half-wave rectifiers?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: identify the two given half-wave blocks P and Q and their transfer plots. Translate them into piecewise outputs: P is active on the positive half-cycle with negative output, while Q is active on the negative half-cycle with positive output. Then analyze Diagram B using ideal-op-amp equations: Q is applied to the non-inverting side through an equal divider, and P is applied to the inverting summing node with equal feedback, so the op-amp output is Q - P. Check half-cycles: for positive input, Q=0 and P is negative, so Q-P is positive; for negative input, P=0 and Q is positive, so Q-P is positive. Therefore the output is full-wave rectified, selecting Diagram B.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中上方给出两个半波整流器模块 P 和 Q 及其传输特性。P 的传输图显示：输入为正半周时输出沿负斜率线变为负值，输入为负半周时输出为 0；Q 的传输图显示：输入为负半周时输出为正值，输入为正半周时输出为 0。下方给出四个候选电路 A、B、C、D，其中图 B 中 P 的输出经电阻 R 接到运放反相端，并有等值反馈电阻 R；Q 的输出经电阻 R 接到同相端，同相端还通过等值电阻 R 接地。推理：由图 B 的同相端分压关系，V+ = Q/2。理想运放负反馈下 V- = V+ = Q/2。反相节点列 KCL，且输入电阻和反馈电阻相等，有 (V- - P)/R + (V- - vo)/R = 0，所以 vo = 2V- - P = Q - P。检查半周：当输入为正时，Q = 0，P 为负，因此 vo = Q - P 为正；当输入为负时，P = 0，Q 为正，因此 vo = Q - P 也为正。输出两半周均为正，即为全波整流输出。因此应选图 B。

method.method_draft: First describe the image: read the P graph as producing a negative output only on the positive half-cycle, and the Q graph as producing a positive output only on the negative half-cycle. A full-wave rectifier needs both half-cycle contributions to appear positive at the final output. Hence the P contribution must be sent through an inverting path, while the Q contribution must be sent through a non-inverting path with matching gain. Compare the labeled circuits visually: Diagram B is the one where P feeds the inverting input through R with feedback R, and Q feeds the non-inverting input through an equal resistor network; the other options either invert/pass the wrong block or combine them with the wrong polarity. Thus the resultant circuit is Diagram B.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：上方给出两个半波整流器模块 P 和 Q。P 内部的传输曲线显示：在输入 vin 为正半周时，输出 vo 为负斜率的负值；在输入为负时输出为 0。Q 内部的传输曲线显示：在输入 vin 为负半周时，输出 vo 为正值；在输入为正时输出为 0。下方四个候选电路 A、B、C、D 都把 P、Q 两个模块接入运放求和/放大网络，但接到反相端或同相端的方式不同。推理：要得到全波整流，最终输出应在两个半周都为正。P 已经在正半周产生负输出，所以 P 的贡献需要经过反相通道变为正；Q 已经在负半周产生正输出，所以 Q 的贡献应经过非反相通道保持为正，并且增益需要匹配。观察候选图，Diagram B 中 P 通过电阻 R 接到运放反相输入端，并有反馈电阻 R，形成反相路径；Q 接到同相输入端的等值电阻网络，形成非反相贡献并匹配增益。其他选项会把 Q 也反相、或把 P/Q 的极性通道接反，不能使两个半周都为正。因此结果电路是 Diagram B。

planner_metadata.text_role: Use the instruction that the two given half-wave rectifiers are to be combined into a full-wave rectifier, so the selected diagram must combine complementary half-cycles into one same-polarity output.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: A full-wave rectifier must produce the same output polarity for both input half-cycles. An inverting input path reverses signal sign, while a non-inverting input path preserves sign, with the equal resistor network setting the proper unity relative gain. The needed operation is therefore non-inverted Q plus inverted P, equivalently Q - P.
